name: Supra Pacific Financial Services Limited
about: Supra Pacific Financial Services Limited operates as a non-banking finance company in India. The company offers fund-based services, including two-wheeler loans, gold loans, and micro-finance services. It also provides trader, auto, business, personal, and working capital loans; non-convertible debentures investment services; and insurance solutions, including life, health, general, motor, home, travel, and liability insurance. The company serves individuals, self-employed customers, small traders, and micro-entrepreneurs. It offers its products and services through its branches. The company was formerly known as Supra Pacific Management Consultancy Limited and changed its name to Supra Pacific Financial Services Limited in June 2023. Supra Pacific Financial Services Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Mumbai, India.
